spec.title: Support task ID slugs
spec.context:
Numeric task IDs (001, 002, etc.) are not memorable. Users cannot tell what a task is about without opening the task file. Directory listings show opaque folder names like 001/, 002/ which don't convey meaning about task content.
Slug-based IDs like 021-support-task-id-slugs provide better recall, are self-documenting, and enable faster navigation by typing partial slugs.

requirements.req: The system shall generate task IDs in format {paddedNumber}-{slug} (e.g., 021-support-task-id-slugs)
The system shall auto-generate slugs from task title using the slugify library with lowercase and strict mode
The system shall truncate slugs to 50 characters maximum
The system shall use the full slug-based ID for task folder names
The system shall extract the numeric portion (before first dash) when looking up tasks by ID
The system shall support partial slug matching in task search
